chunks: From the servant of Allah, Ali, the Commander of the Faithful, to the people of Kufah, who are the forefront of the Ansar and the crest of the Arabs.
ai.seo_question: What is the opening address of Imam Ali's letter to the people of Kufa?
ai.summary: This salutation serves as a political and spiritual declaration, establishing Imam Ali’s authority not merely as a ruler but as the 'Commander of the Faithful' (Amir al-Mu'minin), a title that gained definitive prominence during his caliphate. By addressing the Kufans as the 'front of the Ansar' and 'crest of the Arabs,' Sharif al-Radi highlights their historical role as the primary military and political base for Ali’s movement, framing their loyalty as both a tribal honor and a religious duty.
